posts.zh:
dsh-vision-proxy 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DeepSeek 大脑 + 自动识图：GUI 附加的每张图片自动经 OpenAI 兼容 VLM 转译成文字，再交给纯文本的 DeepSeek 作答——有 key 自动走快速通道（默认 qwen3.7-flash，支持百炼/智谱/OpenRouter 等任意 OpenAI 兼容端点），无 key 自动探测本地 Ollama（零配置，图片不出本机）。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3d370b73c724b1bc5f9b.html
posts.en:
dsh-vision-proxy is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. DeepSeek brain + automatic image transcription: attach images in the GUI and each one is transcribed to text via any OpenAI-compatible VLM before reaching the text-only DeepSeek — a keyed fast path (default qwen3.7-flash; DashScope/Zhipu/OpenRouter or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) with your own key, or local Ollama auto-detected with zero config.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-3d370b73c724b1bc5f9b.html
